summary: Sole dependency resolved from an off-registry HTTP URL, enabling install-time code execution
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's only dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as the bare URL https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async instead of a registry version range. Installing the package causes npm to fetch and install whatever tarball that host returns, running any lifecycle scripts contained in it, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no registry provenance. The host is unrelated to any declared publisher metadata (the repository field is a placeholder github.com/example/... URL). The shipped code is a one-line stub that re-exports that dependency, so the manifest line is effectively the entire published surface: whoever controls artifacts.koliroute.com controls code that executes on the installer's machine at install and require time, and the delivered content can change at any time without a new package version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
